jlc-pofv.dru_text:
(version 1)
# Generated by pnr.fab_profile (profile jlc-pofv); docs/fab-comparison.md 5A/5B.
# Rewritten on every project stamp and native DRC: edit pnr/fab_profile.py.
# 5A SMD pad to pad, different nets (clearance applies to different nets only)
(rule "jlc-pofv_smd_pad_to_pad"
  (constraint clearance (min 0.15mm))
  (condition "A.Type == 'Pad' && B.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'SMD' && B.Pad_Type == 'SMD' && A.NetClass != 'Default' && B.NetClass != 'Default' && A.NetClass != 'power' && B.NetClass != 'power'"))
# 5A Vias in SMD pads: via copper to SMD pad 0.127 (any net); 5B Via-in-pad via: only the filled 0.20-drill in-pad class may enter an SMD pad
(rule "jlc-pofv_via_to_smd_pad"
  (constraint physical_clearance (min 0.127mm))
  (condition "A.Type == 'Via' && A.Hole > 0.2mm && B.Type == 'Pad' && B.Pad_Type == 'SMD'"))
# 5A Via hole to copper (vias and via-class footprint holes under 5A Component PTH hole 0.30)
(rule "jlc-pofv_via_hole_clearance"
  (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.2mm))
  (condition "(A.Type == 'Via' || (A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && A.Hole_Size_X < 0.3mm && A.Hole_Size_Y < 0.3mm))"))
# 5A NPTH hole to copper
(rule "jlc-pofv_npth_hole_clearance"
  (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.2mm))
  (condition "(A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'NPTH, mechanical')"))
# 5A PTH hole to copper (component PTH: 5A hole 0.30 or more)
(rule "jlc-pofv_pth_hole_clearance"
  (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.35mm))
  (condition "(A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && (A.Hole_Size_X >= 0.3mm || A.Hole_Size_Y >= 0.3mm)) && !(B.Type == 'Via' || (B.Type == 'Pad' && B.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && B.Hole_Size_X < 0.3mm && B.Hole_Size_Y < 0.3mm))"))
# 5A Hole-to-hole, via to via
(rule "jlc-pofv_via_hole_to_hole"
  (constraint hole_to_hole (min 0.25mm))
  (condition "(A.Type == 'Via' || (A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && A.Hole_Size_X < 0.3mm && A.Hole_Size_Y < 0.3mm)) && (B.Type == 'Via' || (B.Type == 'Pad' && B.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && B.Hole_Size_X < 0.3mm && B.Hole_Size_Y < 0.3mm))"))
# 5B Filled via hole to any regular PTH or NPTH
(rule "jlc-pofv_filled_via_to_pad_hole"
  (constraint hole_to_hole (min 0.45mm))
  (condition "(A.Type == 'Via' || (A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && A.Hole_Size_X < 0.3mm && A.Hole_Size_Y < 0.3mm)) && ((B.Type == 'Pad' && B.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && (B.Hole_Size_X >= 0.3mm || B.Hole_Size_Y >= 0.3mm)) || (B.Type == 'Pad' && B.Pad_Type == 'NPTH, mechanical'))"))
# 5A Hole-to-hole, any pair involving a component PTH
(rule "jlc-pofv_component_pth_hole_to_hole"
  (constraint hole_to_hole (min 0.5mm))
  (condition "(A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && (A.Hole_Size_X >= 0.3mm || A.Hole_Size_Y >= 0.3mm))"))
# 5A NPTH 0.50 or more
(rule "jlc-pofv_npth_min_drill"
  (constraint hole_size (min 0.5mm))
  (condition "(A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'NPTH, mechanical')"))
# 5A Hole to edge 0.5mm to the outline centreline (KiCad measures to the stroke edge: minus half the 0.15mm Edge.Cuts stroke)
(rule "jlc-pofv_hole_to_edge"
  (constraint physical_hole_clearance (min 0.425mm))
  (condition "A.Layer == 'Edge.Cuts' || B.Layer == 'Edge.Cuts'"))
